objects.description: Debug utility class providing formatted time-stamped logging to an Arduino Stream. It maintains an initialization flag, a pointer to a Stream for output, and an internal debug level (none/default/all). Methods allow configuring the output stream and level, printing/logging, and emitting time and free-heap diagnostics. Construction is default; initialization of the stream must be performed via stream(Stream&, blinker_debug_level_t). Destruction behavior is default; ownership of Stream is not taken (raw pointer).

functions.name: BLINKER_FreeHeap
functions.description: Returns the amount of free heap memory. Intended for use on Arduino/embedded targets to inspect current memory availability.
requirements: Must be compiled in an Arduino/embedded environment where heap querying is supported (header includes Arduino.h/WProgram.h).
Return value semantics (units, exact meaning) are not documented in this header; assumed to be bytes.

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::stream
functions.description: Initializes the BlinkerDebug instance with an Arduino Stream to output logs and sets the debug verbosity level. Must be called before using print/println or other logging helpers.
requirements: The Stream reference s must refer to a valid, initialized Stream (e.g., Serial) and must remain valid for the lifetime of its use by BlinkerDebug.
Should be called before any call to BlinkerDebug::print/println or template logging helpers to avoid dereferencing a null Stream pointer.

The level argument controls verbosity; default is _debug_default. Exact semantics of levels are:
- _debug_none: no logging
- _debug_default: normal logging
- _debug_all: verbose logging

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::debugAll
functions.description: Sets the debug verbosity level to the most verbose (_debug_all). Use after stream() to enable all logs, including those guarded by isDebugAll().
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream should have been called to ensure internal state is initialized; otherwise changing the level may have no effect on output.
A valid Stream must be configured for any logs to be emitted.

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::time
functions.description: Emits a time/timestamp prefix to the configured debug Stream. Used by BLINKER_LOG_TIME and other logging helpers to prefix log lines.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream must have been called; this function likely writes to the internal Stream.
Behavior regarding whether it prints when debugging is disabled is not documented in this header (unknown).

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::freeheap
functions.description: Logs the current free heap memory to the configured debug Stream.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream must have been called; this function likely writes to the internal Stream.
Requires an Arduino/embedded environment where free heap can be queried.
Behavior when debugging is disabled is not documented in this header (unknown).

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::isDebug
functions.description: Returns true if the debugger is initialized and the current debug level is not _debug_none. Use to guard normal debug logging.
requirements: No special requirements; safe to call before initialization. Returns false if BlinkerDebug::stream has not been called.

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::isDebugAll
functions.description: Returns true if the debugger is initialized and the current debug level is _debug_all. Use to guard verbose/trace logging.
requirements: No special requirements; safe to call before initialization. Returns false if BlinkerDebug::stream has not been called.

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::print
functions.description: Writes the given value to the configured Stream using Stream::print. Thin wrapper used by logging helpers.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream must have been called prior to use; this function directly dereferences the internal Stream pointer and will crash if uninitialized.
Type T must be printable by Arduino Stream::print (i.e., there must be a suitable overload).

functions.name: BlinkerDebug::println
functions.description: Writes the given value followed by a newline to the configured Stream using Stream::println.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream must have been called prior to use; this function directly dereferences the internal Stream pointer and will crash if uninitialized.
Type T must be printable by Arduino Stream::println (i.e., there must be a suitable overload).

functions.name: BLINKER_LOG_TIME
functions.description: Emits a timestamp prefix for log messages. Typically delegates to BlinkerDebug::time(). Used by logging helpers to prefix each message.
requirements: Intended for Arduino environments; exact formatting/side effects are not documented here (unknown).
Should be callable regardless of debug level; usage in BLINKER_LOG is unconditional.

functions.name: BLINKER_LOG_FreeHeap
functions.description: Logs current free heap memory at the normal debug level.
requirements: Requires an Arduino/embedded environment where heap can be queried.
May rely on BlinkerDebug being initialized with a Stream; exact behavior when uninitialized or when debug is disabled is not documented (unknown).

functions.name: BLINKER_LOG_FreeHeap_ALL
functions.description: Logs current free heap memory at the most verbose (ALL) debug level.
requirements: Requires an Arduino/embedded environment where heap can be queried.
May rely on BlinkerDebug being initialized with a Stream; exact behavior when uninitialized or when debug is disabled is not documented (unknown).

functions.name: BLINKER_LOG_T
functions.description: Base-case overload for the recursive variadic logging helper. Terminates recursion of BLINKER_LOG_T(T, Ts...). Implementation is external.
requirements: No arguments. Intended to be called only by the templated BLINKER_LOG_T during recursion termination.

functions.name: BLINKER_LOG
functions.description: Convenience variadic logger. Emits a timestamp prefix via BLINKER_LOG_TIME, then logs all arguments via BLINKER_LOG_T. Intended for normal debug logging.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream should have been called so that BLINKER_LOG_T can print safely.
Each argument type must be printable by Arduino Stream::print.
BLINKER_LOG_TIME must be linked/provided; its exact behavior is not defined here.

functions.name: BLINKER_ERR_LOG
functions.description: Error-level logger. When debugging is enabled, emits a timestamp, prints "ERROR: ", then logs all arguments via BLINKER_LOG_T.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream must have been called; uses BLINKER_DEBUG.print internally.
Each argument type must be printable by Arduino Stream::print.
Only emits output if BLINKER_DEBUG.isDebug() returns true.
Relies on Arduino F() macro via BLINKER_DEBUG_F for the "ERROR: " literal; requires Arduino environment.

functions.name: BLINKER_LOG_ALL
functions.description: Verbose-level variadic logger. When BLINKER_DEBUG.isDebugAll() is true, emits a timestamp and logs all arguments via BLINKER_LOG_T.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream should have been called so that printing is safe.
Each argument type must be printable by Arduino Stream::print.
Only emits output if BLINKER_DEBUG.isDebugAll() returns true.

functions.name: BLINKER_ERR_LOG_ALL
functions.description: Verbose-level error logger. When BLINKER_DEBUG.isDebugAll() is true, delegates to BLINKER_ERR_LOG to emit a timestamp, "ERROR: ", and the provided arguments.
requirements: BlinkerDebug::stream should have been called so that printing is safe.
Each argument type must be printable by Arduino Stream::print.
Only emits output if BLINKER_DEBUG.isDebugAll() returns true.

BlinkerDebug::isDebug
BlinkerDebug::isDebugAll
